fields.label: Quotation Terms
fields.default:
1. PAYMENT TERMS : 100% ADVANCE.
  2. ALL PRICES ARE FINAL AND EXCLUSIVE OF ALL TAXES.
  3. ALL PRICES ARE ON EX FACTORY BASIS AND NO ADDITIONAL DISCOUNT WILL BE EXTENDED.

  5. NO ORDERS SHALL BE PROCESSED WITHOUT RECEIVING 100% ADVANCE PAYMENT.
  6. VALIDITY OF QUOTATION IS MAXIMUM 1 MONTH AND PRICES MAY CHANGE WITHOUT ANY PRIOR INTIMATION.
  7. THE COMPANY SHALL NOT BEAR ANY RESPONSIBILITY FOR ANY DAMAGE OCCURRED TO THE GOODS WHILE IN TRANSIT.
  8. ANY ISSUE REGARDING QUALITY OF THE PRODUCT OR ANY OTHER COMPLAINTS OR GRIEVANCES SHOULD BE RAISED IN WRITING BY MAIL OR WHATSAPP WITHIN 15 DAYS OF THE BILLING DATE. THE COMPANY WILL NOT ATTEND TO ANY COMPLAINTS AND GRIEVANCES AFTER 15 DAYS OF THE BILL DATE.
